summary: Pyrophyte Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting that, following shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting, it issued a $1.2M non-interest-bearing promissory note to its sponsor (Fourth Extension Note) to fund monthly deposits into the trust account and extend the deadline for an initial business combination (Extension Amendment). It also amended a working capital convertible promissory note, extending the maturity date. The sponsor may convert up to $1.5M of that note into warrants at $1.00 per warrant. These actions are standard SPAC extension mechanics designed to avoid liquidation and buy more time to find a target. Watch for an eventual business combination announcement or a liquidation if no deal closes by the Extended Date.
